sn10.8:1.1: This story, which tells of the conversion of the Buddha’s chief layman follower, is also found in the Vinaya at [pli-tv-kd16:4.1.1]().| The Cool Grove was a pleasant place to meditate, notable as the place where the Buddha moderated the monk Soṇa’s excessive striving ([an6.55]()).
sn10.8:1.12: Sivaka appears alongside Mucalinda at [dn32:10.12](). Mucalinda supported the Buddha after his awakening, as Sivaka supports Anāthapiṇḍika here. Sivaka might be identified with Shiva (see [sn2.21]()).
sn10.8:2.1: The commentary expands this number to 100,000, but the Chinese parallels at SA 592 and SA2 186 prefer the more modest and literal figure of 100.
